step1_figure.page: Not in provided PDF (Index indicates Chapter 18/19)
step1_figure.description: The circuit consists of a logic block (SUB_1) acting as a phase splitter or PFD that drives a push-pull charge pump (xmu and xmd). The charge pump adds or removes charge from a large loop filter capacitor (C1 = 7.5nF). Notably, the pull-up device (xmu) is an NMOS transistor, which limits the maximum output voltage to VDD - VTHN.

output_high_voltage.description: Maximum output voltage, limited by the NMOS pull-up transistor (xmu) operating as a source follower.

equation.explanation: The NMOS pull-up transistor stops conducting when its VGS drops below the threshold voltage VTHN. Since the gate is driven to VDD, the source (Vout) can only reach VDD - VTHN.
equation.assumptions: Body effect is neglected in the simplified calculation, though it will increase VTHN in reality.

sky130_expected.reasoning: The typical value is 1.38V without body effect. With body effect (VSB > 0), VTHN increases, which will lower the actual VOH to around 1.1V - 1.2V.

charge_pump_current_down.description: Discharge current through the pull-down NMOS (xmd) when Vout is at VDD/2.

equation.explanation: When Down is high (1.8V) and Vout is 0.9V, xmd is in the triode region because VDS (0.9V) < VGS - VTHN (1.8V - 0.42V = 1.38V).
equation.assumptions: Assuming W/L = 1 for the parameterized device.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the exact W/L ratio provided during instantiation and short-channel velocity saturation effects not captured in the long-channel equation.

charge_pump_current_up.description: Charge current through the pull-up NMOS (xmu) when Vout is at VDD/2.

equation.explanation: When Up is high (1.8V) and Vout is 0.9V, xmu is in saturation because VDS (0.9V) > VGS - VTHN (0.9V - 0.42V = 0.48V).
equation.assumptions: Assuming W/L = 1 for the parameterized device.

sky130_expected.reasoning: The pull-up current is severely limited because xmu is an NMOS source follower. Body effect will further increase VTHN, reducing VGS-VTHN and dropping the current even lower than 32uA.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure the charge pump's maximum output voltage (VOH) and the rise/fall times, which reflect the UP and DOWN charge pump currents charging/discharging the 7.5nF loop filter capacitor.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Charge Pump Testbench
.lib ${SKY130_PDK} tt

* Define missing parameters with default W/L=1/0.15
.param W_xmu=1 L_xmu=0.15 W_xmd=1 L_xmd=0.15
.param W_xm1i=1 L_xm1i=0.15 W_xm2i=1 L_xm2i=0.15
.param W_xm1a=1 L_xm1a=0.15 W_xm2a=1 L_xm2a=0.15
.param W_xm3=1 L_xm3=0.15 W_xm4=1 L_xm4=0.15
.param W_xm2=1 L_xm2=0.15 W_xm1=1 L_xm1=0.15
.param W_xm8=1 L_xm8=0.15 W_xm11=1 L_xm11=0.15 W_xm12=1 L_xm12=0.15

VDD VDD 0 DC 1.8
Vs Vs 0 DC 1.8
* 100us period to allow the 7.5nF capacitor to charge/discharge
Vin Vin 0 PULSE(0 1.8 1u 10n 10n 40u 100u)

* --- DUT Netlist ---
xmu Vs N001 N002 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xmu} l={L_xmu}
xmd N002 N003 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xmd} l={L_xmd}
C1 Vout 0 7.5e-09
X_X1 Vin Vs N001 N003 SUB_1
L1 N002 Vout 0.0001
Rload Vout 0 10000.0

.subckt SUB_1 In Vs Up Down
  X_X1 N004 Up Vs Fig18_39
  X_X2 N005 Down Vs INV_240_80
  X_X3 N001 N004 Vs INV_240_80
  X_X4 N003 N001 Vs INV_30_10
  X_X5 N007 N005 Vs INV_30_10
  X_X6 N006 N007 Vs INV_30_10
  X_X7 N002 N003 Vs INV_30_10
  X_X8 In N008 Vs INV_30_10
  X_X9 In N005 N002 Vs NAND_2
  X_X10 N001 N008 N006 Vs NAND_2
.ends SUB_1

.subckt Fig18_39 In Out VDD
  xm1i N001 In 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm1i} l={L_xm1i}
  xm2i N001 In VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm2i} l={L_xm2i}
  C2 N002 B 5p
  xm1a N002 N001 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm1a} l={L_xm1a}
  xm2a N002 N001 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm2a} l={L_xm2a}
  xm3 Out N001 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
  xm4 Out N001 B B sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm4} l={L_xm4}
  C1 N001 A 1p
  xm2 B A VDD 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}
  xm1 A B VDD 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm1} l={L_xm1}
.ends Fig18_39

.subckt INV_240_80 In Out VDD
  xm1 Out In 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm1} l={L_xm1}
  xm2 Out In VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}
.ends INV_240_80

.subckt INV_30_10 In Out VDD
  xm1 Out In 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm1} l={L_xm1}
  xm2 Out In VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}
.ends INV_30_10

.subckt NAND_2 A B Out VDD
  xm3 out B VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
  xm8 out A VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm8} l={L_xm8}
  xm11 N001 B 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm11} l={L_xm11}
  xm12 out A N001 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm12} l={L_xm12}
.ends NAND_2
* --- End DUT Netlist ---

.control
  tran 100n 200u
  
  * Measure max and min voltages to verify VOH limitation
  meas tran v_max max v(Vout)
  meas tran v_min min v(Vout)
  
  * Measure rise time (indicative of UP charge pump current)
  meas tran t_rise trig v(Vout) val=0.2 rise=1 targ v(Vout) val=1.0 rise=1
  
  * Measure fall time (indicative of DOWN charge pump current)
  meas tran t_fall trig v(Vout) val=1.0 fall=1 targ v(Vout) val=0.2 fall=1
  
  print v_max v_min t_rise t_fall
  quit
.endc
.end
